prompt: Camera holds still in the aisle. Right away the thin clerk, standing among the seated bidders, lifts paddle 29 a little higher with a weary sigh, his shoulders sagging, the worn folder tucked under his other arm. The paddle number "29" stays crisp and readable, and the board on the right keeps showing "£150,000" unchanged. A murmur spreads through the marquee; a few seated people turn their heads to look at him. The man at the lectern on the right keeps gesturing silently. The festoon bulbs glow steadily; rain falls lightly on the tent roof. Only the clerk moves much; he does not speak. Sound: a rising murmur of a crowd, rain on canvas, a chair creak. Soft overcast light through the marquee.
